mentions.name: aix
mentions.description: This CLI tool standardizes AI agent configuration the way npm and package.json standardize JavaScript packages. It lets users define AI config in one spot and install it to tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor, and share the config with others.
mentions.source_excerpt: aix - Like the npm CLI and package.json, but for AI config. Allows standardizing your AI config to share with others, and defining it all in one spot but installing to Claude, Codex, Cursor, etc.: https://aix.a1st.dev/
